descriptor: A platform specializing in African travel, offering a comprehensive range of travel services and AI-assisted features.

requirements.statement: The system must allow customers to book flights, hotels, and safaris as part of a single trip.
The system must support a major section dedicated to African travel, including safaris and cultural experiences.
The system must enable travel advisors to create customized trip proposals within 30 minutes.
The system must integrate with accounting software for financial tracking.
The system must flag uncertain customer requests for travel advisor review.
The system must provide a CRM to track leads, customers, and booking history.
The system must allow customers to view and manage their itineraries through a secure portal.
The system must support secure authentication and role-based permissions.
The system must generate professional quotes and itineraries for customers.
The system must handle group travel bookings with shared itinerary information.
The system must support AI capabilities to assist customers in exploring destinations and generating trip ideas.
The system must track supplier information including contracts and rates.
The system must allow customers to make payments and track their remaining balances.
The system must support the creation of detailed safari products with itineraries and pricing.
The system must provide analytics on revenue, bookings, and customer data.
The system must support marketing capabilities such as email campaigns and customer segmentation.
The system must maintain audit logs for all transactions and changes.
The system must support scalability to accommodate multiple advisors and thousands of customers.

releases.name: Customer Portal and Security

releases.demo: Generate a professional quote and book a group trip.
releases.goal: Enable quotation system and group travel bookings.
releases.name: Quotation and Group Travel

releases.demo: AI suggests trip ideas and supplier data is managed.
releases.goal: Introduce AI features and manage supplier information.
releases.name: AI Assistance and Supplier Management

releases.demo: Process a payment and display analytics dashboard.
releases.goal: Complete payment processing and analytics capabilities.
releases.name: Payments and Analytics

stories.title: Book a complete trip including flight, hotel, and safari
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want to book a complete trip including flight, hotel, and safari, so that I can manage my travel in one place.
acceptance: Given a customer selects a flight, hotel, and safari, when they proceed to checkout, then the system confirms the booking as one trip.
Given a customer selects unavailable dates, when they try to book, then the system shows an error message.
Trust: The system logs the booking transaction in the CRM.
stories.task_guidance: Implement booking flow for flights, hotels, and safaris. Ensure CRM integration for transaction logging.

stories.title: Create a dedicated African travel section
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want to explore African travel options, so that I can plan a specialized trip to Africa.
acceptance: Given a customer navigates to the African section, when they select a safari, then detailed safari information is displayed.
Given a customer selects an unsupported destination, when they try to view details, then the system shows a message to contact an advisor.
Trust: The system logs customer interactions with the African section.
stories.task_guidance: Develop African travel section with safari details and CRM logging for interactions.

stories.title: Flag uncertain requests for advisor review
stories.narrative: As a travel advisor, I want uncertain customer requests flagged, so that I can review and assist them.
acceptance: Given a customer makes an unclear request, when the system processes it, then it flags the request for advisor review.
Given a customer provides complete information, when the system processes it, then it does not flag the request.
Trust: The system logs all flagged requests for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement request processing logic to identify and flag unclear requests for review.

stories.title: Enable integration with accounting software for transaction logging
stories.narrative: As a travel advisor, I want the system to integrate with accounting software, so that all transactions are logged and auditable.
acceptance: Given a completed transaction, when it is processed, then it should be logged in the accounting software.
Given a failed transaction, when it is attempted, then it should not be logged in the accounting software.
Trust: Given any transaction, when it is processed, then an audit log entry must be created.
stories.task_guidance: Ensure integration with the specified accounting software API for transaction logging and audit trail creation.

stories.title: Implement secure customer portal
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want a secure portal to manage my trips, so that I can access my travel details safely.
acceptance: Given a customer logs in, when they enter correct credentials, then they access their portal.
Given a customer enters incorrect credentials, when they try to log in, then the system denies access.
Trust: The system logs all login attempts for security audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop secure login and portal access for customers to view and manage trips.

stories.title: Implement role-based permissions
stories.narrative: As an admin, I want role-based permissions, so that users have appropriate access levels.
acceptance: Given a user logs in, when they have admin rights, then they access admin features.
Given a user logs in, when they have customer rights, then they access customer features only.
Trust: The system logs all access attempts and changes in permissions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement role-based access control for different user roles.

stories.title: Generate professional quotes for customers
stories.narrative: As a travel advisor, I want to generate professional quotes, so that customers receive clear and detailed pricing.
acceptance: Given a quote is generated, when a customer views it, then it displays without internal costs.
Given a quote is modified, when it is saved, then the system updates the customer view.
Trust: The system logs all quote generations and modifications.
stories.task_guidance: Develop quote generation system with customer-friendly output and internal logging.

stories.title: Support group travel bookings
stories.narrative: As a group organizer, I want to book travel for multiple people, so that I can manage a group trip efficiently.
acceptance: Given a group booking is initiated, when details are complete, then the system confirms the booking for all members.
Given a group booking is incomplete, when submitted, then the system prompts for missing information.
Trust: The system logs all group booking transactions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement group booking functionality with shared itinerary and CRM logging.

stories.title: AI suggests trip ideas to customers
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want AI to suggest trip ideas, so that I can explore travel options easily.
acceptance: Given a customer provides preferences, when AI processes them, then it suggests relevant trips.
Given a customer provides no preferences, when AI processes, then it suggests popular trips.
Trust: The system logs all AI suggestions for review.
stories.task_guidance: Develop AI module to process customer preferences and suggest trips.

stories.title: Manage supplier information
stories.narrative: As a travel advisor, I want to manage supplier information, so that I can maintain accurate records.
acceptance: Given a supplier is added, when details are saved, then it appears in the supplier list.
Given a supplier is updated, when changes are saved, then the system reflects the updates.
Trust: The system logs all supplier data changes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop supplier management module for adding and updating supplier details.

stories.title: Process customer payments and track balances
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want to make payments and track my balance, so that I can manage my travel expenses.
acceptance: Given a payment is made, when processed, then the system updates the balance.
Given a payment fails, when retried, then the system processes it again or shows an error.
Trust: The system logs all payment transactions.
stories.task_guidance: Implement payment processing and balance tracking with integration to accounting software.

stories.title: Provide analytics on revenue and bookings
stories.narrative: As a manager, I want analytics on revenue and bookings, so that I can make informed business decisions.
acceptance: Given data is available, when analytics are generated, then they display revenue and booking trends.
Given data is incomplete, when analytics are generated, then the system highlights missing data.
Trust: The system logs all analytics generation activities.
stories.task_guidance: Develop analytics dashboard for revenue and booking data visualization.

stories.title: Create customized trip proposals for travel advisors
stories.narrative: As a travel advisor, I want to create customized trip proposals within 30 minutes, so that I can efficiently serve my clients.
acceptance: Given a new trip request, when a travel advisor creates a proposal, then it should be completed within 30 minutes.
Given a trip proposal, when it exceeds 30 minutes, then the advisor should be notified of the delay.
Trust: Given any trip proposal, when it is created, then an audit log entry must be created.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a user interface for travel advisors to input trip details and generate proposals quickly.

stories.title: Implement CRM for tracking leads, customers, and booking history
stories.narrative: As a sales manager, I want a CRM to track leads, customers, and booking history, so that I can manage relationships effectively.
acceptance: Given a new lead, when it is added to the CRM, then it should be visible in the lead list.
Given a customer booking, when it is completed, then it should update the customer's booking history.
Trust: Given any CRM entry, when it is modified, then an audit log entry must be created.
stories.task_guidance: Develop CRM features to manage leads, customers, and booking history with audit logging.

stories.title: Support creation of detailed safari products with itineraries and pricing
stories.narrative: As a product manager, I want to create detailed safari products with itineraries and pricing, so that I can offer comprehensive travel packages.
acceptance: Given a new safari product, when it is created, then it should include itineraries and pricing.
Given an existing safari product, when its itinerary is updated, then the changes should be reflected immediately.
Trust: Given any safari product, when it is created or updated, then an audit log entry must be created.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a module for creating and managing safari products with detailed itineraries and pricing.

stories.title: Ensure system scalability for multiple advisors and thousands of customers
stories.narrative: As a system architect, I want the system to support scalability, so that it can accommodate multiple advisors and thousands of customers.
acceptance: Given an increase in user load, when multiple advisors access the system, then it should maintain performance.
Given a surge in customer activity, when thousands of customers interact with the system, then it should not crash.
Trust: Given any system load, when it scales, then performance metrics must be logged.
stories.task_guidance: Implement load balancing and performance monitoring to ensure system scalability.
